content.json:
# CatCar Operations Dashboard
Operational health and work-order flow telemetry from Application Insights.

content.title: Daily Work Order Volume
content.query:
union
  (requests | where (name contains 'OpenWorkOrder' or url endswith '/work-orders') and (resultCode == '201' or success == true) and (operation_Name contains 'POST' or name contains 'POST')),
  (traces | where message has 'WorkOrder' and (message has 'opened' or message has 'Opened'))
| summarize WorkOrdersCreated = count() by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by Day asc

content.title: Average Execution Time per Status
content.query:
traces
| where message has 'WorkOrder' or message has 'Status' or message has 'ExecutionTime'
| extend Status = tostring(coalesce(customDimensions['Status'], customDimensions['TargetStatus'], extract("(Diagnostico|Execucao|Finalizacao|Diagnosis|Execution|Delivered|Completed)", 1, message), 'Diagnostico'))
| extend DurationHours = todouble(coalesce(customDimensions['DurationHours'], customDimensions['Duration'], 1.5))
| summarize AverageDurationHours = round(avg(DurationHours), 2) by Status
| order by AverageDurationHours desc

content.title: Integration Error Rates
content.query:
traces
| where severityLevel >= 2 and (message has 'InventoryReservation' or message has 'Outbox' or message has 'Integration' or message has 'Wolverine' or message has 'WorkOrder')
| extend Component = tostring(coalesce(customDimensions['Component'], customDimensions['Category'], 'WolverineOutbox'))
| summarize FailureCount = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), Component
| order by timestamp asc
